heading: About Me
paragraphs:
Hey, I'm Jonathan Idy.
I'm a business-focused full‑stack engineer (Next.js, NestJS, Node.js) who builds automation‑driven platforms that solve real operational problems and deliver measurable business value.

Recent work includes Elenem — a SaaS for sports leagues that automates game management and standings — and LeBourgeois, a flight booking platform in the DRC that aggregates airline schedules and fares to boost conversions.
I design systems where efficiency matters, turning messy workflows into scalable solutions. If you'd like to connect, reach me at rajjysrachid@gmail.com.
